gettransfer.rule: Reserve for transfer-coverage gaps; exact route usefulness must be confirmed owner-side.

kkday.rule: Use where KKday inventory is materially useful for the destination; do not duplicate a stronger existing Klook/Viator action without reason.

wegotrip.rule: Use for self-guided city/museum contexts only where exact destination inventory exists.

ekta.rule: Optional travel-protection utility only. Never fear-based, never presented as required, and never on Earth-view ranking surfaces.

12go.rule: Use only for exact route/destination utility after owner-project availability is confirmed; never on live-view cards.

omio.rule: Research-only until owner-project availability is confirmed. If available, use for explicit rail/bus/ferry/flight route planning and suppress overlapping transport options.

travel-medical-insurance.rule: Research-only; choose at most one provider after owner-side availability/terms review. Never fear-based or required.
